nodes.name: go_with_the_flow_rules_v3_0_clean.csv
nodes.summary: Canonical CSV register of the Go-with-the-Flow v3.0 governance ruleset (GOV/ARCH/CLI/VAL/FIN/TEST/TYPE rules) that constrains how the DutchBay model is developed, validated, and merged. Each row pins a rule id, category, description, and CI/review enforcement mechanism.

nodes.name: install_dev_tools.sh
nodes.summary: Bash bootstrap script that activates the .venv311 virtualenv and pip-installs the developer toolchain (pytest, hypothesis, coverage, pylint, flake8, black, isort, mypy, bandit) plus web frameworks, then freezes versions to requirements_dev.txt. Sets up a reproducible local quality-tooling environment.

nodes.name: mypy.ini
nodes.summary: Mypy static-type-checking configuration that sets strictness flags and per-module overrides for the DutchBay finance/analytics packages. Enforces the typed-first (TYPE-01) governance rule in fast-lane CI.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Central project metadata and build configuration for the dutchbay-epc-model package (v14.15.0): declares the setuptools build backend, runtime dependencies (numpy, pandas, scipy, omegaconf, pydantic, numpy-financial), optional dev extras, and tool sections for ruff, black, mypy, and pytest.

nodes.name: pytest.ci.ini
nodes.summary: Pytest configuration profile used specifically in CI, defining test paths, markers, and collection options tuned for the fast-lane continuous-integration run of the financial model test suite.

nodes.name: pytest.ini
nodes.summary: Default local pytest configuration declaring test discovery paths and markers for the DutchBay model test suite. Used for developer-machine test runs outside CI.

nodes.name: requirements-export.txt
nodes.summary: Single-line requirements file pinning the dependency needed for Excel/artifact export functionality in the model pipeline.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Fully pinned production dependency manifest (202 entries) for the DutchBay EPC financial model, locking exact versions of numpy, pandas, scipy, omegaconf, pydantic, and the rest of the runtime stack for reproducible installs.

nodes.name: requirements_dev.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned developer/test dependency manifest (pytest, mypy, ruff, black, isort, hypothesis, coverage and related tooling) generated by pip freeze, used to provision the quality-assurance toolchain.

nodes.name: requirements_era5.txt
nodes.summary: Dedicated dependency manifest for the ERA5 wind-data processing workflow, installing xarray, netCDF4, and the scientific stack needed to ingest reanalysis wind resource data for AEP estimation.

nodes.name: ruff.toml
nodes.summary: Ruff linter/formatter configuration defining selected lint rule sets, line length, and per-file ignore overrides for the DutchBay codebase. Enforces code-style consistency across the model.

nodes.name: schema.md
nodes.summary: Short reference document specifying the EPC parameters schema (base_cost_usd, freight_pct, contingency_pct, fx_rate) with units, valid ranges, and notes for the cost-engine configuration.

nodes.name: setup_venv.sh
nodes.summary: Bash setup-and-validation script that ensures a Python virtualenv exists and is active and installs dependencies from requirements.txt for the DutchBay model. Provides a guarded, colorized provisioning entry point for the project environment.

nodes.name: tox.ini
nodes.summary: Tox multi-environment test matrix configuration running the Go-With-The-Flow CI pipeline (black, isort, pytest-xdist, mypy, coverage, flake8, pylint, bandit) across Python 3.8 through 3.13 for the financial model.

nodes.name: validate.sh
nodes.summary: Bash quality-validation script that runs the static-analysis gauntlet (mypy, ruff, black, isort, pylint) against swimlane1_inspector.py, exiting on first failure. Automates pre-commit style and type checking for a target module.
